resolution.note: blockerOf in the lane run accepted only a plain final BLOCKER line while Stop accepts bold or non-final ones; a session ending on one shipped its commit. Shared reader, regression test in test/cli/lane-run.test.ts. Outside rows not rerun.

title: Outside lanes cannot merge with unproven clauses or without a red-at-base test
body:
Why: outside acceptance 1115h on KRN 43b1123/4d798ad merged npm d4839fe with proof clauses 0/4 red-first 0 (.krn/runs/outside/npm.log:300) and py 1ec203a with clauses 0/3 red-first 0 (.krn/runs/outside/py.log:339), although t-qjqsdvj and t-k031r25 made both Stop arms default.
Outcome: the cause is named (arm not reached, env/contract makes the repo vacuous, proof counter wrong, or ship path bypasses Stop) and fixed so an outside lane whose proof line shows clauses below N/N or red-first 0 on a fix/feature task cannot reach ship; the proof line and the Stop decision read the same records.
Files: src/hook/stop.ts, src/cli/lane-run/verdict.ts, src/cli/lane-run/delivery.ts, tests.
Proof: a regression test on verbatim captures of the npm.log/py.log lane records is red before the fix; rerun of outside npm and py rows shows clauses N/N and red-first >=1 per merged lane.
